recipes.name: Struggle Meals
ingredients: freshly ground black pepper, to taste
instructions: For Congee:
For the Congee

In a pot, combine water and rice. Cover and bring to a simmer, holding the lid until the rice has reached the consistency of porridge. The time will vary depending on the type of rice you’re using. - 4 cups water - ½ cup rice unrinsed
Once the congee has reached your desired consistency, transfer to a serving bowl and salt to taste. - salt - For the Congee
For the Toppings

Slice onion, bell pepper, and mushrooms, in a sauté pan and cook until fragrant and softened, about 10 minutes. - ¼ white onion thinly sliced - ½ bell pepper thinly sliced - 1 ½ mushrooms thinly sliced
Cook the bacon until crispy, then crumble into bite-sized pieces. - 1 ½ strips of bacon
Add any variety of savory toppings you choose. I used banana peppers and chili oil. - For the Congee - For the Toppings
Season with salt to taste, and serve hot! - salt
For Spaghetti Neopolitan:
For the Pasta
Bring a large pot of heavily salted water to a boil. - salt
For the Sauce
Cut sliced bacon into bite-sized pieces. - 4 slices bacon
In a cold nonstick pan, add the bacon and about a tablespoon of the heavily salted water. - bacon
Then turn the heat on medium high and cook, stirring occasionally with a rubber spatula, until the fat has rendered and the bacon is crispy. - 4 slices bacon - ⅓ cup pasta water
Transfer the bacon to a paper towel-lined plate leaving as much fat in the pan as possible. - 4 slices bacon
Add the mushrooms to the nonstick pan and toss quickly over medium heat. Sauté until the liquid has evaporated and the mushrooms are lightly caramelized. - 1 cup baby bella mushrooms sliced
Add the onion, green bell pepper, and salt. Sauté until fragrant and slightly browned. - ½ white onion thinly sliced - ½ green bell pepper thinly sliced - salt
For the Pasta
Once the vegetables are nearly done cooking, add the spaghetti to the boiling water. - ½ lb spaghetti
For the Sauce
Add the pasta water, soy sauce, and ketchup to the pan with the vegetables. Stir to combine. - ⅓ cup pasta water - 1 tbsp soy sauce - ¾ cup ketchup
Increase the heat to medium-high and cook, stirring, until the sauce begins to caramelize. - For the Sauce
For the Spaghetti Neopolitan
When the pasta is just under 1 minute shy of al dente, transfer it directly to the sauce. - For the Pasta - For the Sauce
Toss to coat, adding pasta water as needed to loosen the sauce. Cover and cook for about 2 minutes. - pasta water as needed - For the Spaghetti Neopolitan

Add the reserved bacon, butter, black pepper, and parmesan cheese. Toss until well combined and glossy. - cooked bacon - 1 tbsp cold butter - freshly ground black pepper to taste - grated parmesan cheese to taste
Taste and adjust for seasoning then garnish with bacon and more parmesan cheese before serving. - cooked bacon - grated parmesan cheese to taste - For the Spaghetti Neopolitan
For Lentil Sloppy Joes:
Cook lentils 5 minutes less than package instructions; set aside. - 1 cup lentils cooked
Sauté mushrooms with a pinch of salt in a nonstick pan over medium heat until moisture evaporates. - 1 cup baby bella mushrooms chopped - pinch of salt
Add oil, onion, and bell pepper; cook until onions are translucent. - cooking oil - ½ white onion chopped - ½ green bell pepper chopped
Stir in cumin, chili powder, and garlic powder; toast until fragrant. - 1 tsp cumin powder - 1 tsp chili powder - 1 tsp garlic powder

Add chicken stock, Worcestershire, ketchup, barbecue sauce, and hot sauce; stir to combine. - ¾ cup chicken stock - 2 tbsp Worcestershire sauce - 1 tbsp ketchup - 1 tbsp barbecue sauce - 1 tsp hot sauce
Add bacon, molasses, and lentils; simmer until thickened to a chili-like consistency. - 2 –3 slices cooked bacon chopped - 1 tsp molasses (or another syrupy sugar) - 1 cup lentils cooked
Spoon onto buns, top with American cheese, and serve hot. - Sloppy Joe buns - American cheese slices
